# Flickr
> Flickr is an online photography platform for sharing, discovering, organizing, and engaging with photos and photographers.

Flickr combines photo hosting, community features, creator tools, events, and editorial content for photographers of all levels.

## Core Platform
- [Home](https://www.flickr.com/): Main entry point for Flickr’s photography community and platform features.
- [Features](https://www.flickr.com/features): Overview of Flickr’s photo sharing, discovery, and organization capabilities.
- [Flickr Pro](https://www.flickr.com/flickr-pro): Premium membership details, benefits, and advanced tools for photographers.
- [The Apps](https://www.flickr.com/features/apps): Information about Flickr’s mobile and device apps.
- [Media Hub](https://www.flickr.com/media-hub): Press resources, announcements, and media materials about Flickr.

## Community
- [Groups](https://www.flickr.com/community/groups): Community groups for shared interests, themes, and collaborative participation.
- [Events](https://www.flickr.com/events): Flickr-hosted events, community activities, and photography gatherings.
- [Explore](https://www.flickr.com/explore): Curated discovery feed highlighting notable and interesting photography.
- [Camera Finder](https://www.flickr.com/cameras): Browse photos by camera make and model used.
- [The Commons](https://www.flickr.com/commons): Public photography archives and cultural heritage collections on Flickr.

## Photographer Tools
- [Upload](https://www.flickr.com/photos/upload/): Upload photos and videos to your Flickr account.
- [Organize](https://www.flickr.com/photos/organize/): Manage albums, metadata, and photo organization workflows.
- [Create Album](https://www.flickr.com/photos/organize/): Organize images into albums and collections.
- [Prints](https://www.flickr.com/prints): Order photo prints and physical products from Flickr images.
- [Stats](https://www.flickr.com/account/stats/): View account performance and engagement metrics for your photos.

## Help & Support
- [Help Center](https://www.flickrhelp.com/): Official support portal for Flickr products, accounts, and troubleshooting.
- [Legal](https://www.flickr.com/help/legal): Legal resources and policy information for using Flickr.
- [Terms](https://www.flickr.com/help/terms): Terms of service governing Flickr accounts and platform usage.
- [Privacy](https://www.flickr.com/help/privacy): Privacy policy describing data handling and user privacy practices.
- [Community Guidelines](https://www.flickrhelp.com/hc/en-us/articles/4404070631700-Community-Guidelines): Rules and expectations for participation on Flickr.

## Company
- [About Us](https://www.flickr.com/company/about-us/): Company background, mission, and information about Flickr.
- [Sustainability](https://www.flickr.com/company/sustainability/): Flickr’s sustainability commitments and environmental initiatives.
- [Advertise](https://www.flickrads.com/): Advertising opportunities and brand partnership information for Flickr.
- [Flickr Foundation](https://www.flickr.org/): Independent organization focused on preserving and understanding photographic heritage.
- [MODE Festival](https://modefestival.com/): Photography festival associated with Flickr and creative community programming.

## Editorial & News
- [Flickr Blog](https://blog.flickr.net/en/): Official blog featuring product news, stories, and photography highlights.
- [Announcements](https://blog.flickr.net/en/category/announcements/): Product updates, launches, and official Flickr news.
- [Community](https://blog.flickr.net/en/category/community/): Stories and updates about Flickr members and community activity.
- [Inspiration](https://blog.flickr.net/en/category/inspiration/): Editorial photography features and creative inspiration for photographers.
- [Tips & Tricks](https://blog.flickr.net/en/category/tips-tricks/): Practical advice for using Flickr and improving photography workflows.

## Discovery
- [Search](https://www.flickr.com/search/): Search across public photos, people, and groups on Flickr.
- [Map](https://www.flickr.com/map): Explore geotagged photography by location on an interactive map.
- [Places](https://www.flickr.com/places): Browse photos associated with cities, regions, and countries.
- [Galleries](https://www.flickr.com/galleries): Curated collections assembled from photos across Flickr.
- [Albums](https://www.flickr.com/photos/tags): Discover public photos through tags and topical browsing.

## Accounts & Membership
- [Sign Up](https://www.flickr.com/signup): Create a new Flickr account.
- [Log In](https://www.flickr.com/signin): Access an existing Flickr account.
- [Flickr Pro Pricing](https://www.flickr.com/flickr-pro): Membership plans and premium feature details.
- [Account Settings](https://www.flickr.com/account): Manage profile, preferences, and account configuration.
- [Notifications](https://www.flickr.com/notifications): Review account alerts and activity updates.
